translation:
I never intended to come face-to-face with
the club president in this unbearable heat.

But, it'll be trouble if I can't convince him that
the unnatural phenomenon wasn't real.
It's really just you alone, right?
That's what I keep telling you.

The president kept randomly checking behind
me.

If I can't get the information I need soon,
Haruhi will probably get bored and come here.

Of course, I'm going to try to get him to give
me some kind of clue to prove it isn't real.

I'm sorry to ask again, but you are alone,
right?
Yeah. Do you see anyone else around?

Well I wouldn't want to say something
unscientific about object permanence, but…
…Where's your brigade chief?
Did Haruhi do something?

I don't even have to go as far as asking, it
seems.

Like hiding in your shadow, or listening in from
the other side of the door.

I don't think she's a ninja, but well, it can't be
helped.

Thinking of Haruhi that way is in line with her
actions, after all.

You don't need to worry about that. She's
headed to the scene of the phenomenon.

I see. That puts me a little at ease at least.
You seem somewhat down to earth.

I understand why he's so cautious after all.
I can even sympathize with him.

It's hard to call him unreasonable after he
had his new computer stolen by such hands.

Anyway, what brings our clubroom neighbor
here?

It's about the so-called phenomena you
computer society guys all experienced.
I'd like to ask for a few more details.
More details, hmm…

I'd appreciate it if you didn't look at me with
such a blatantly suspicious gaze.

Point that at our beloved brigade chief, not
me.

That would be Haruhi getting what she
deserves.

Though, I'd rather anything than for that to
cause trouble for the rest of the brigade.

What are you planning to do after hearing
what we have to say?

I'm trying to prevent our brigade chief from
causing you guys any more trouble.
I thought I'd take some advanced measures.
…Can I really believe what you're saying?

Fair enough, it's not something anyone would
just believe right away.

From his point of view, I seem like an
accomplice of our theft incident.
And you won't cause us any trouble?
Yeah, neither directly nor indirectly.
What do you mean, "indirectly”?

Don't worry about that, to get back on
subject…

If Haruhi gets in a weird mood and breaks the
balance of this room…

He might get captured by another giant cave
cricket for all I know.

I'd rather we avoid having to mount a rescue
by not mixing him up in such a sorry affair.

Alright. For now, I don't want to have any
more involvement with your brigade chief.
Right…

He said "for now,” so does that mean he does
want something with her at some point?
Hey, tell him about your experience.
What do you want to hear about?

Would you mind telling me what happened from
beginning to end again?
Again? Well, whatever.

It was when I was walking around and putting
up posters.
Posters?

Yeah. Our club was in charge of putting up
posters about water conservation.

We often don't have enough water in the
summer, you know?

Right. There's not enough water, so every
year you raise awareness about saving it.

Unfortunately, a lot of students aren't
aware about saving water.

We created the posters on request from the
student council.
I see…

Maybe it was stupid of me to ask him to go
through the story from beginning to end.
He started going on about ecology.
I need him to get to the point.

Basically, you had your experience when
putting up posters, didn't you?

That's right. It was when I was putting them
up in the halls and the class noticeboards.

For some reason, I suddenly began to feel a
weird sensation.
A weird sensation?

It was that, mysteriously, the hallway felt
longer than usual. Impossible, right?

I don't want to admit it, but it's possible.
For now, I'll just accept it and move on.

Well, I suppose you're right. By the way, where
did it happen?

The hallway where class 1-9 is. It leads to a
dead end, right?
Right, I understand.

Koizumi is in class 1-9. I've had to drag my
feet over there plenty of times.

I thought it was weird, but I kept putting up
the posters until I realized.

I must've been confused because of staying
up all night at school, is what I thought.
That's a totally understandable reaction.

I thought it was ridiculous and laughed it off,
but when I turned around…
It was right in front of my eyes.
Class 1-10.
Is that so…

There are only nine classes in our first year,
right?

Yeah. There's no class 10 classroom. You
weren't mistaking it for another room?
I also thought I was mistaken.

But, I saw it there clearly… A 1-10 plate over
the door.
Really…

If this unnatural phenomenon was caused by
Haruhi…
Then it should be different from what I saw.
When did this happen?

I don't remember exactly, but it was a few
days ago.

In other words, it was before Taniguchi
phoned me about the unnatural phenomena.

Once Haruhi heard they had experienced
these unnatural phenomena…

That's when she got interested… That's what
would have influenced her, right?

This guy had his experience earlier than
that, so he was probably just mistaken, right?

Hey, take a look at the poster. It's a pretty
cool design, isn't it?

The poster he was proudly showing me was
eye-catching at a glance.

Maybe the design was too intricate, because
it was hard to decipher what was even written.
What does this say?
It's H?O, the chemical symbol for water.
Ah, now that you mention it, I can see it.

The characters for water conservation are
pretty common, so I tried to put a spin on it.

I want to ask what the point of a poster that
needs an explanation is.

I feel like they were so distracted by type-
setting that they missed the core purpose.
Is something wrong?
Well, just…

You say "H?O” is written, but… isn't this the
wrong character?

They probably didn't notice because they
were so focused on the design.
Maybe I should point it out…

If I point out the mistake, they should owe me
a favor in return.
Isn't this the wrong character?
Huh, what about it is wrong?
The "2” looks misshapen, so it's hard to read.
Ah, you're right, it's wrong!
Was I overstepping my bounds there?
Not at all. It's a great help.

The computer society's reputation would've
been ruined!

I'd better gather them up and redo them… I'm
truly grateful.
It's nothing.
A [#P05poster] misprint[#P01], huh…

If this benefits me later, I'm not going to
complain.

If I keep interjecting like this, I'll end up
annoying him, though.
So then, did you not enter the 1-10 classroom?

Hm, yeah. I didn't exactly have any reason to.
I was tired, so I went straight back.

He could leave…? That's completely different
from my experience then.

Was the situation he encountered much less
severe than mine?

So, is that the general situation with your
unnatural experience?

Yeah, that's all there was to it. It was just
creepy.
Thank you for telling me about it.
I don't know if it'll be helpful to you.
Well, whatever, that's how it was.
Thank you very much.

Is your brigade chief going to be satisfied
now, having heard all that?

Honestly, I'd be surprised if she'd be satisfied
that easily.

Right… Is there anything else you want to
ask?
Let me see…

They seem to be acting quite cooperatively.
While I'm here, I might as well ask some things.
Why is your club staying over at school?
And I mean doing all-nighters.

Yes…we're in the middle of developing a fairly
big program.
A computer program?

We are the computer society, so we need
something to show for the school festival.

So that's why you're spending your summer
together at school… What kind of program?
I can't tell you that just yet.

Well, you'd better look forward to when it's
done!

In particular, a part that I want your
brigade chief to look forward to! Hehehe…
Right…

Why the hell do the club president's words
sound so suggestive?

Just earlier too, he said "for now,” which
packs some hefty implications.

You wouldn't expect him to want something to
do with Haruhi, so just what is he thinking?
Will your club be presenting something?
Huh? At the school festival?

I don't know what you're going to be doing,
but surely you're doing something, right?

From an outsider perspective, do we look like
we're going to be presenting something?
I guess not… Don't mean to be rude.
You'll make me upset if you say it like that.
Huh, what? That's strange… where did it go?

Suddenly the complexion of the club
president's face changed.

He got so flustered I thought he'd seen
Haruhi. It even made me turn around and check.
What happened, Prez?

Hey, the memory card with our data on it, it's
not with you, is it?
No, I haven't seen it…
You didn't lose it, did you?

Then by some chance, maybe I left it in the
computer lab…

If you lost that, all our effort until now will
have meant nothing!
Wait wait, if I just calm down, I'll remember.

I probably left it behind with my laptop.
I'll go check later.

It seems like some kind of serious situation
has occurred.
Now's not the time to ask questions.
Well, I'm sorry for taking your time…
Huh?

I found something dropped outside of the
computer society room…

Could this be the club president's so-called
lost memory card?

…There's nothing written on it about the
contents.

I'll pick it up and have a look, but it just
seems like a normal memory card.
Hm… it's got "Comp Research” written on it.
Should I return this to them?
No, wait a second.

He told me to look forward to it in such a
suggestive manner…

I can't help but imagine this would really
interest Haruhi.

I do think it's the moral choice to return lost
items where they belong, but…

In this case, perhaps it would be more humane
to use this to divert Haruhi's attention.

If the school turns into alternate space, it'll
get the whole neighborhood involved, after all.

No, even more than that, there's a possibility
the whole world could collapse, right?
Well, what should I do…?
I guess I'll borrow the memory card after all.

If I don't divert Haruhi's attention elsewhere,
things might get serious.

If I can keep Haruhi's attention, the space
might stabilize.

I'm sorry Mr. President, but this is for the
sake of world peace.

If you want it back, you can have it after
that, no problem.
I'll just borrow this for a bit.
I picked up the [#P05memory] card[#P01].

If it comes to it, we could use this as a means
to confront the Computer Research Society.
I'm feeling worse and worse for them, but…

I want to hold off world-ending events as
much as I can, you know?

If we're lucky, Haruhi might completely forget
about the new seven wonders.
…That would, of course, be awful.

Returning what you find is the moral way of
doing things.
…There's something else dropped here.

I picked it up. It seemed to be a bookmark with
"pure heart” written on it.
Is this bookmark mocking me?

The perfect timing of its appearance was not
lost on me as I picked it up.

It's unclear if this is something the president
dropped, and it doesn't seem to be important.
The club president will probably find it himself.

I should leave the memory card where I found
it.

I'm not interested in going out of my way to
deliver it just to be suspected.
I'll leave the interviewing at that.
Point out typo
Say nothing
Borrow the memory card
I can't do that.
